title: About
text:
Gnoll Pack Analytics, LLC is led by John M. A. Wojahn, PhD FLS (aka Michael), an evolutionary plant biologist. Michael earned his PhD in Evolution, Ecology, and Behavior – Global Change Emphasis from Boise State University in Winter 2025.
He has authored multiple publications and developed the G2PMineR R package for the NSF EPSCoR GEM3 project, an automated literature review tool that has been cited in numerous research papers.
At Gnoll Pack Analytics, we offer a wide range of bioinformatics services, from basic statistical analyses to full genomic assembly and custom analysis pipelines. Our goal is to provide flexible, high-quality solutions tailored to your research needs.
Why "Gnoll Pack"? A gnoll is a fantasy creature from Dungeons & Dragons, resembling an anthropomorphic hyena. Just like a gnoll pack works together to achieve its goals, we're committed to collaborating with our clients to tackle complex bioinformatics challenges.

title: Welcome!
text:
At Gnoll Pack Analytics, we are dedicated to providing the highest quality bioinformatics consulting experience. Whether you need a quick consultation or a full-service pipeline development and execution, we have a solution tailored to your needs.
Our streamlined approach allows us to offer competitive pricing without compromising on quality: lower overhead means more value for you compared to traditional institutional services.
Ready to get started? Schedule a FREE 25-minute consultation today and join the Gnoll Pack on your bioinformatics journey!
